The evidence explicitly states the formula `depth = log2(tree->gridlength)+2` and `step = rc.n_y / depth`. Mathematically, for any valid `gridlength >= 1`, `log2(gridlength) >= 0`, so `depth >= 2`. Since `depth` is at least 2, it is non-zero, which prevents division by zero in the calculation of `step`.
